job.title: WHS & Facilities Coordinator
job.description:
Are you an experienced HSE or Facilities professional looking for a role where you can make a genuine impact across workplace safety, compliance and site operations?

Our client is an established, innovative technology organisation with a modern manufacturing facility based in Glenorchy, Tasmania. They are seeking a proactive and solutions-focused HSE & Facilities Coordinator to take ownership of health, safety and environmental compliance while ensuring their facilities remain safe, compliant and operating efficiently.

This is a varied, hands-on position offering the opportunity to work across HSE, facilities, contractor management, preventative maintenance and emergency preparedness. You will work closely with operational and technical teams and play an important role in continuing to build a positive, practical safety culture.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Maintaining maintenance schedules, permits, certifications and asset documentation
  • Monitoring HSE and facilities expenditure and supporting budget management
  • Obtaining quotations, negotiating with service providers and supporting procurement activities
  • Maintaining emergency response plans and coordinating emergency drills and preparedness activities
  • Supporting business continuity and risk mitigation initiatives.
About You
You will be an organised, practical and solutions-focused professional who is comfortable taking ownership and working across multiple priorities.
You will bring:
  • A Diploma in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Facilities Management or a related discipline, or 3–5 years' relevant experience in a similar HSE and Facilities position
  • Previous HSE and/or facilities coordination experience, ideally within a manufacturing, construction or industrial environment
  • Strong knowledge of workplace compliance, risk management and safety practices
  • Excellent organisational and coordination skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities
  • Confidence working with contractors, suppliers and service providers
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly around compliance and documentation
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
  • Competency with Microsoft Office and process flow software
  • Unrestricted Australian working rights.
Why Apply?
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys having a broad scope of responsibility rather than being confined to a purely administrative HSE position.
You'll join an innovative, technically focused organisation where safety, operational efficiency and continuous improvement are genuinely important. The role offers exposure across manufacturing, technical operations and facilities, with the opportunity to influence systems, processes and workplace culture.
If you're looking to take ownership of HSE and facilities within a collaborative Hobart-based business, we'd love to hear from you.
